name: maat
description: Build, run, and diagnose executable UI tests with Maat.

interface.longDescription: Prepare Web and native UI test platforms, explore persistent Sessions, save executable Maat Cases, and diagnose Evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check Maat and the selected platform, then guide setup until it is ready or clearly blocked.
Explore the target UI, build a minimal Maat Case from my explicit objectives, and validate it in a fresh Session.
Run the requested Maat tests, inspect the results and Evidence, and explain any failures.
